spoken_first_2s: डॉक्टर साहब मेरे को बहुत कमजोरी है और

notes.hook: 'Doctor sahab, mujhe bahut kamzori hai' -> 'badaam kaju daal ke phoonk maar ke piyo'
notes.what_goes_wrong: A forwarded WhatsApp joke acted out word for word; no new character, twist or visual, so there is nothing to share.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: acting out a joke that is already on WhatsApp; if people know the punchline, the reel is dead.
